verdict.rationale: Bento's CLI lets you manage tags (bento-docs-49), and you can bulk create or update subscribers through the API (bento-docs-14). The subscribers endpoint filters by tags or a segment, which lets you read back who is in each (bento-docs-8). However, there is no evidence that segments can be created or updated programmatically; segments appear to be saved filters built in the segment builder (bento-docs-42, bento-docs-26). Missing for 10: API endpoints to create or update segments, explicit tag add/remove endpoint documentation, list support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of exact membership readback.
